items.title: WHO prequalifies multi-dose RSV vaccine vial, paving the way to protecting more infants globally
items.summary: The World Health Organization listed a 9 September 2026 departmental update saying it had prequalified a multi-dose respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine vial.
items.whyImportant: WHO said the prequalification is paving the way to protecting more infants globally.
keyFacts: Development: A multi-dose RSV vaccine vial was prequalified
WHO described the development as paving the way to protecting more infants globally
verificationIssues: The supplied evidence is a WHO newsroom listing rather than the full departmental update.
The candidate's explanation of procurement, country use, cost and supply constraints is not stated in the supplied evidence and has been removed.

items.title: Dr Vanessa Kerry appointed to new role as WHO Director-General's Special Envoy for Health Resilience
items.summary: The World Health Organization announced that Dr Vanessa Kerry has been appointed as the WHO Director-General's Special Envoy for Health Resilience.
items.whyImportant: WHO announced the creation of this new envoy role and the appointment of Dr Vanessa Kerry.
keyFacts: Role: WHO Director-General's Special Envoy for Health Resilience
verificationIssues: The supplied evidence supports the appointment and date, but does not support claims about outbreak preparedness, health-system shocks, global emergencies, or the role being a dedicated senior position.

items.title: NASA’s Hubble, Webb Find Far-out Solar System Objects ‘Remember’ Past
items.summary: NASA reported that the Hubble Space Telescope and James Webb Space Telescope found far-out Solar System objects that “remember” the past.
keyFacts: NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope and James Webb Space Telescope are named in the report.
The report concerns far-out Solar System objects.
NASA published the report on September 8, 2026.
verificationIssues: The supplied evidence supports the NASA headline and publication date, but does not include the article body; claims about specific observations, physical characteristics, or Solar System formation and evolution are not supported by the provided text.
The candidate image URL is not supported by the supplied evidence and has been removed.
